explanation: I fails because f_xy=x^3 and f_yx=y^3 cannot agree throughout an open set. II is realized by f=e^(x+y)−2xy, with both mixed partials e^(x+y)−2. III is realized by f=(2/3)(x−1)^(3/2)−3y on the open set x>1, where all required derivatives are continuous. Thus II and III only are possible.
